user.description:
Route ESPHome voice satellites' responses to other media players. Satellites are added as entries under the integration.

Routes found in patched ESPHome options to import: {count} ({titles}).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Satellite Router is already set up; add satellites to it.

data_description.media_players: Where responses play. The first one's volume is passed to the listening script.
data_description.stt_script: Runs when the satellite starts listening, with media_player_entity_id and media_player_volume_level (e.g. to duck the speakers).
data_description.tts_script: Plays the response, with entity_id (TTS engine), message, language, options and the fields above. Without it, tts.speak plays the message on the media players.

error.unknown_satellite: That satellite isn't in the entity registry.

abort.already_configured: That satellite already has a route.

incompatible_esphome.title: Satellite Router can't hook ESPHome
incompatible_esphome.description: This version of the ESPHome integration changed in a way Satellite Router doesn't support ({reason}). Satellites behave normally (responses play on the satellites) until Satellite Router is updated.

patched_core.title: ESPHome is patched to route satellites
patched_core.description: This Home Assistant's ESPHome integration has the satellite TTS/STT script options patched in. Satellite Router is inactive so responses aren't routed twice. Remove the patch (or this integration).
